name: cumulative_logical
setup: L = logical([1 0 1 1]); P = logical([1 1 0 1]); Mx = logical([0 1 0 1]); Mn = logical([1 1 0 1]); A = logical([1 0; 1 1]);
expr: ys = cumsum(L); yp = cumprod(P); ymx = cummax(Mx); ymn = cummin(Mn); c2 = cumsum(A); r2 = cumsum(A,2); rev = cumsum(L,'reverse');
comment: cumsum/cumprod/cummax/cummin on logical input. cumsum/cumprod PROMOTE logical->double; cummax/cummin PRESERVE the logical class (verified MATLAB R2025b). Covers vector, 2-D column + dim2, and 'reverse'. char still errors on both engines (numeric-or-logical only). bugs/builtin/cumulative-logical.md.
